messages:
oliver-finops: Noticed a weird net revenue delta after last night's backfill. Several corrected invoices were posted but tax amounts are missing in NetSuite for those entries. Can we trace what the backfill did?

sam-eng: looking at the backfill job logs (batch-backfill-2026-03-15). It processed 412 invoices. I see a warning: 'tax_lookup returned null for item_code X-RED-001' during NS create_line call. The code assumes tax_code exists for all items.

levi-billing: that sounds like a product catalog mismatch. Did we recently rename tax codes in NetSuite? I recall a cleaning of legacy tax items last week.

ana-acct: if tax codes were renamed and we posted without tax, that under-collects sales tax. Need emergency remediation and accounting memo. Which customers and amounts?

sam-eng: quick query: select ns_invoice_id, customer_id, amount, tax_amount from backfill_audit where tax_amount = 0 and original_stripe_tax > 0 -> returned 9 invoices total, combined tax shortfall $1,234.56.

billing-backfill-bot: Backfill job log excerpt: 'INFO processed invoice 2026-03-14-INV-9012; WARN tax_lookup(item=X-RED-001) -> null; creating line without tax.'

levi-billing: root cause: tax mapping table maps stripe_tax_code -> ns_tax_item. During the tax cleanup a few NS tax items were renamed (ns_tax_US_VAT -> ns_tax_us_vat) and our mapping keys are case-sensitive. The backfill used mapping and when lookup failed, the connector defaulted to tax_amount=0 instead of erroring.

sam-eng: minimal fix: change tax_lookup to be case-insensitive and fail the job for unmapped tax codes rather than silently posting. I'll open a hotfix PR. Also add a CI check that validates mapping completeness for any batch run.

oliver-finops: remediation priorities: 1) identify affected invoices and create correcting tax adjustments in NetSuite, 2) communicate to customers if necessary, 3) ensure GL corrected. Accounting needs audit notes.

ana-acct: approve tax adjustments in NS. For each corrected invoice create a separate tax adjustment with memo 'Auto-tax-adjust: mapping mismatch; original backfill omitted tax. Source backfill batch-backfill-2026-03-15'. Also include original stripe_tax_reference in memo. We'll review materiality at month-end.

levi-billing: I'll prepare a script to re-run tax_lookup for the 9 invoices, attach the correct ns_tax_item, and create tax-only invoice lines or tax memos depending on NS capabilities. We'll tag each adjustment with 'source:backfill-1765504321' in a custom field.

sam-eng: PR details: 1) tax_lookup lowercases keys before matching, 2) when mapping not found, raise error and push to DLQ instead of writing invoice with zero tax, 3) add an automated preflight that scans mapping table against items present in a backfill payload and fails early. Link PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/999 (draft).

billing-backfill-bot: Created ticket BILL-1507: tax mapping case-sensitivity bug; created DLQ entries for invoices that failed mapping earlier (9 entries).

oliver-finops: can we backfill the correct tax without affecting customer balances (i.e., create tax memos rather than updated invoices)? Customers already saw corrected invoice amounts but missing tax line.

levi-billing: yes. We'll create tax memos that apply to the invoice and post the tax liability to the correct GL. That avoids rebilling customers. For customers whose payments already cleared, we'll create AR adjustments to keep ledger balanced.

ana-acct: please ensure each tax memo includes the original invoice id and the stripe_invoice_id in the memo field. Also attach the batch id and ticket number for audit. Good to go on tax memos approach.

sam-eng: deploying fix to staging for verification now. After QA we'll toggle feature flag to stop backfills from auto-posting until mapping preflight succeeds.

levi-billing: starting remediation run in staging to simulate creating tax memos for the 9 invoices. Will post a dry-run CSV with columns: ns_invoice_id, stripe_invoice_id, customer_id, expected_tax, ns_tax_item, remediation_action.

billing-backfill-bot: Action: scheduled job BILL-1507-REMEDIATE to run in 30 minutes after staging verification.

oliver-finops: timeline looks OK. Please do not post to prod until accounting approves the exact memos. We need the CSV for sign-off.

levi-billing: CSV uploaded: https://internal/redwood/billing/remediation/batch-backfill-2026-03-15-taxfix.csv (contains 9 rows). Posted CS to Ana for approval.

ana-acct: reviewed CSV, approved tax memos for the 9 invoices. Please include 'approved by ana-acct' in each memo and attach this Slack thread ID for traceability.

sam-eng: fix merged to main and feature flag preventing auto-post backfills enabled. Planning prod deployment in 10 minutes after final checks.

levi-billing: remediation job ran in prod and created tax memos: NS-TAX-20260315-01..09. Posted reversing entries where payments had cleared. Audit notes added. Closing DLQ items.

oliver-finops: thanks team. Can we add an automated nightly check that flags any invoice where stripe_tax_amount > 0 and ns_tax_amount = 0 for 24h? Want to catch regressions faster.

sam-eng: good idea. I'll add the monitoring metric and an alert to finance-oncall if mismatch_count > 0.

billing-backfill-bot: Completed: BILL-1507 remediation; DLQ cleared; monitoring rule added.

oliver-finops: great. Please send short executive summary to finance@redwood with the list of affected invoices and GL impact.

levi-billing: will compile summary and send by EOD. Thanks all.
